final_topology.title: Resilient Branch Office Network
final_topology.description: Design for a branch office with redundant routers, MPLS WAN connectivity, and survivable voice capabilities.
final_topology.topology_summary: The branch office will have redundant routers connected via MPLS to the main data center. It will also have direct connections to the PSTN and a SIP provider for survivable voice functionality.

controls.title: Establish and Maintain Detailed Enterprise Asset Inventory
controls.evidence: The topology includes an 'Asset Inventory System' (n_new1) in the Management Zone (z3), which suggests the presence of an asset inventory system.

controls.title: Document Data Flows
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'Data Flow Documentation System' (n21) in the Documentation Zone (z10), indicating that data flow documentation is being maintained.

controls.title: Segment Data Processing and Storage Based on Sensitivity
controls.evidence: The topology includes multiple zones (e.g., Data Center, Management Zone, Security Zone, Non-Production Zone) that suggest segmentation based on data sensitivity.

controls.title: Implement and Manage a Firewall on Servers
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'Firewall' (n8) in the Branch Office Zone (z1), which is connected to both the Primary and Secondary Routers (n1, n2).

controls.title: Configure Trusted DNS Servers on Enterprise Assets
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'DNS Server' (n9) in the Branch Office Zone (z1), which is connected to both the Primary and Secondary Routers (n1, n2).

controls.title: Require MFA for Remote Network Access
controls.evidence: The topology includes an 'MFA/Identity Server' (n10) in the Management Zone (z3), which is connected to both the Primary and Secondary Routers (n1, n2).

controls.title: Use DNS Filtering Services
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'DNS Filtering Service' (n22) in the Security Zone (z4), which is connected to both the Primary and Secondary Routers (n1, n2).

controls.title: Maintain and Enforce Network-Based URL Filters
controls.evidence: The topology includes a 'URL Filtering Service' (n23) in the Security Zone (z4), which is connected to both the Primary and Secondary Routers (n1, n2).

controls.title: Establish and Maintain a Secure Network Architecture

controls.title: Manage Access Control for Remote Assets

controls.title: Collect Network Traffic Flow Logs

controls.title: Deploy a Network Intrusion Prevention Solution
controls.evidence: The topology includes an 'IDS/IPS' (n12) in the Security Zone (z4), which is connected to both the Primary and Secondary Routers (n1, n2) and the SIEM (n13).

controls.title: Deploy Port-Level Access Control

controls.title: Perform Application Layer Filtering

findings_before.title: empty_zone_without_node
findings_before.missing_reason: Zone z5 has no concrete node assigned to it.
findings_before.repair_suggestion: Add one representative concrete node in this zone and connect it with node_links to the nearest hub, firewall, router, or management/security node.

findings_before.title: ig3_missing_ig2_zone_semantics
findings_before.missing_reason: IG3 topology removed or failed to preserve IG2 zone semantics.
findings_before.repair_suggestion: Add the missing IG2 zone semantics to IG3 as preserved or stricter zones, with representative nodes and concrete node_links. IG3 may add controls but must not reduce segmentation.
